title: Ghost in the Tank? Colony Panics! 👻 | Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony | English Cartoon Comedy
description:
Ek raat colony ki sabse oonchi tanki se ajeeb awaaz aayi aur poora mohalla ek pair pe khada ho gaya! Tanki mein bhoot hai ya sirf ek bada drama? Gang ke sab members apni apni theory le kar nikal pade, aur har koshish ek nayi comedy ban gayi. Kuch chatpati chaal, kuch chaalaaki aur bahut saari hansi. Kahani ka ant aapko chaunka dega! Lesson: jo dikhta hai woh hamesha sach nahi hota, aur darr se zyada shor machaane wale log aksar sabse bade drama queen nikalte hain. Hamare channel ko subscribe karo aur har hafte nayi episode dekho.
